name: QHB Welded Wide Channel Plate Heat Exchanger
full_description: The official product page describes this model as a fully welded clamped plate heat exchanger in which plate bundles are welded from multiple plates and tightly fixed by clamping plates and high-performance bolts. The product is designed to treat media containing solid particles, fiber suspensions, and viscous fluids, with structures that support inspection, maintenance, and cleaning from four sides.
advantage: U-shaped welding structure between sheet pairs for stronger pressure-bearing capacity.
Imported fully automatic laser welding without damage to the plate.
Wear-resistant surface treatment improves corrosion resistance and service life.
